03 / A LITTLE MORE ABOUT ME

Curiosity, on and off the clock.

I’m exploring AI agents and compute infrastructure: how to build useful intelligence, and the systems that make it work.

I studied Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Kharagpur, completing my bachelor’s and master’s degrees between 2013 and 2018. Along the way, I was a teaching assistant for Compilers and Data Structures.

Outside work, it’s house music, driving, gaming, fine dining, and cocktail bars. I love a good evening with friends, I’m always happy to help, and I tend to say yes when there’s a plan.

House music. Open roads. Good company.
